working_features: Accepts a text file path as a command-line argument
Displays total character count including and excluding whitespace
Displays total word count
Displays total line count
Displays total sentence count (detecting sentence boundaries by punctuation)
Calculates and displays average word length
Calculates and displays average words per sentence
Shows the top 10 most frequent words with their counts
Shows character frequency distribution for alphabetic characters
Identifies the longest and shortest words in the text
Calculates a readability score (e.g. Flesch-Kincaid or similar formula)
Displays an error message if the file does not exist or is empty
Output is formatted in clear sections with headers
